mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status = 'ASSIGNED', assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by_type = 'USER', updated_by_id = #{actorId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion}

mapper.select:
SELECT t.ticket_id, t.ticket_no, t.creation_intent_key, t.origin_type, t.catalog_item_id, t.requester_user_id, t.previous_attempt_ticket_id, t.subject, t.description, t.status, t.assignee_user_id, t.workflow_definition_id, t.workflow_version_id, t.workflow_version_no, t.first_processable_at, t.resolved_at, t.closed_at, t.last_reopened_at, t.reopen_count, t.lock_version, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM ticket t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND t.requester_user_id = #{scopeId} AND t.assignee_user_id = #{scopeId} AND (t.requester_user_id = #{scopeId} OR t.assignee_user_id = #{scopeId})
AND t.status = #{status} AND t.origin_type = #{originType} AND t.catalog_item_id = #{catalogItemId} AND t.created_at >= #{createdFrom} AND t.created_at <= #{createdTo}
AND (
t.ticket_no t.created_at t.updated_at
> <
#{cursorValue} OR (
t.ticket_no t.created_at t.updated_at
= #{cursorValue} AND t.ticket_id
> <
#{cursorId}))
ORDER BY
t.ticket_no t.created_at t.updated_at
ASC DESC
, t.ticket_id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{pageSizePlusOne}
